title: LEAKAGE_SCRUB.json - pipeline-leakage scrub gate verdict
description: Produced by /paper-writing Step 3.5 (8-class regex scrub gate, v3.3). /paper-compile refuses to compile when status != PASS (BLOCKED, reason_code: pipeline_leakage_not_scrubbed). Note: 'status' here uses the gate's own PASS|FAIL vocabulary, not the 6-state audit vocabulary.

version.description: Gate version, e.g. v3.3. Free-form so future revisions do not break validation.

status.description: Zero remaining hits required to PASS; any remaining hit is FAIL.

classes_seen.description: Leakage classes (A-H) detected during the grep pass.

checked_files.description: Files grepped (main.tex, sections/*.tex, math_commands.tex, incl. sections/Z_reproducibility.tex).

scrubbed_to.description: Rewrite target description, e.g. 'neutral academic prose'.
